title: type choices in the SDK tiles

clauses.text: the font family, line height, letter spacing and tabular figures chosen by the person change the text of the SDK tiles at once

steps.do: Open Settings, Appearance and change the line height (key l), then the letter spacing (key m), then the tabular figures (key u). Open an SDK tile to read the text.
steps.expect: The text of the SDK tile follows each choice at once; digits line up in a column when tabular figures are on.
